# Give the engine e2e tier a CI runner that reports what it covers

## Context

Split from `#17853` so that ticket can stay open on its remaining criterion while the delivered half lands.

`#17853` establishes that the e2e tier runs in no CI workflow — 104 spec files, 60 of them dock or multi-window, executed by nothing. Its six ACs have since been ruled on by its author, @neo-opus-grace ([ruling](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17853#issuecomment-5562777163)): AC-1 amended and met, AC-3 through AC-6 met, and **AC-2 — a classifier path predicate — deferred as a follow-up with a named home**, because building a separate workflow multiplied its cost from two lines inside `test.yml` to either duplicating ~200 lines of classifier or extracting a reusable one. Grace's words: *"#17853 stays open on AC-2. I am not closing it on the merge."*

PR `#18404` therefore cannot carry `Resolves #17853` — merging it would auto-close a ticket both its author and I intend to keep open. This ticket is the leaf that PR actually delivers.

Live latest-open sweep: checked the latest 12 open issues at 2026-09-06T23:06Z; no equivalent. A2A claim sweep over tonight's nightshift: `#18406` (@neo-gpt-emmy), `#18400` (@neo-gpt), `#18401` (@neo-opus-grace) — none on e2e CI wiring.

## The Problem

No workflow calls `playwright.config.e2e.mjs`. Not gated — never called. So an e2e arm's green is *someone ran it by hand once, on some tree*, and an arm can rot for weeks invisibly.

Two structural limits bound what CI can run, both established empirically rather than assumed:

- **GPU** — specs booting the workstation app inherit animated OffscreenCanvas work no hosted runner composites.
- **Time** — @tobiu's ceiling is five minutes of test time, and the full Brain-free set takes 7.2m serial.

A third bounds the reporting: `testIgnore` DESELECTS the Brain-dependent specs rather than skipping them, so a run missing four fifths of the tier still prints `Skipped: 0`. A naive wiring buys a green badge certifying 14 of 104 files with the rest invisible — **a worse false green than the honest absence it replaces.**

## The Fix

A dedicated `E2E (engine tier)` workflow running the canvas-free, build-independent selection serially under `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI=true`, with `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` as the single source for both the invocation and the coverage report so the two cannot describe different populations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A workflow executes e2e specs on `pull_request` and `push` to `dev`.
- [ ] The test step is bounded to five minutes, separately from provisioning.
- [ ] The job summary states the fraction covered and names every excluded population — Brain-deselected, GPU, build-dependent, and selected-but-quarantined — each with an owner.
- [ ] The selection floor fails the job when a path goes stale or an exclusion is undeclared, at the invocation boundary rather than after the runner starts.
- [ ] A controlled `src/` mutation turns the tier red, proving it gates rather than reports.

## Out of Scope

- The classifier path predicate — that is `#17853`'s remaining AC-2, and its correct implementation is a reusable-workflow extraction rather than a second copy of the predicate.
- The Brain-dependent tier (84 files) and the GPU tier (4 files).
- Repairing the excluded and quarantined arms; they carry owners, not fixes, in this delivery.

## Related

- `#17853` — the parent finding, staying open on AC-2.
- PR `#18404` — the delivery.
